links.outcome: Attribute-level FHIR mapping accuracy under reduced context and varying temperature settings
links.effect: Baseline best mean accuracy 80.61% (GPT-4o) and 69.54% (Llama 3.3 70B); under low context and varying temperature, GPT-4o 73.23%-76.77% and Llama 3.3 70B 54.31%-58.31%.
links.quote: Across temperature settings, GPT-4o achieved mean attribute-level mapping accuracies ranging from 73.23% (SD 2.92) to 76.77% (SD 1.14), whereas Llama 3.3 70B ranged from 54.31% (SD 4.17) to 58.31% (SD 2.23).

unlisted_practices: Clustering-based context recovery to improve candidate FHIR resource identification under reduced context
Schema-guided prompting for LLM mapping of clinical data to FHIR

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance on a pipeline for mapping clinical data to HL7 FHIR standards using the MIMIC-IV dataset; it is an automated benchmark study of technical accuracy without testing a distinct deployment practice/guardrail.
